debug.purpose: CI verification artifact only; never a production identity.

release.purpose: Production/release identity for the locked Android 11 / API 30 distribution scope.
release.identityProvenance: Observed from keytool -list -v on dreams-release.jks and dreams-release.p12 on 2026-08-31; CI must independently reproduce this fingerprint before build unlock. Android 11/API 30 accepts APK Signature Scheme v2 or higher; the locked distribution scope therefore requires v3 plus the pinned certificate rather than redundant simultaneous v2+v3 blocks.

rules: Private key material must never be committed to the repository.
Release signature validity is insufficient without a pinned expected certificate SHA-256 identity.
CI must independently read the supplied release keystore and match expectedCertificateSha256 before build.
The locked Android 11/API 30 release must verify with APK Signature Scheme v3 or a future explicitly approved stronger scheme; v1-only artifacts are forbidden.
APK Signature Scheme v2 is not independently required when v3 is present because every supported ToolBox release device is Android 11/API 30 and Android 11 requires v2 or higher.
Any certificate rotation requires an explicit lineage/update of this contract and invalidates affected release proof.
The exact APK verified here must be the exact APK installed, tested, attested and distributed.
